## Discriminant Functions 

A discriminant is a function that takes an input vector and assigns it to one of $K$ classes, denoted by $C_k$. 
The discriminant function that we will study here is the linear discriminants for which the decision surfaces are hyperplanes. 

### Two Classes 

The simplest representation of a linear discriminant function is obtained by taking a linear function of the input vector 

$$
y(x) = w^T x+ w_0
$$
